proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our shotgun house porch had three soft boards and a wobbly rail. They replaced the boards, tightened every spindle and painted it to match. Ready for our Derby party.
reviews.name: Marisol T.

reviews.text: The screen door on our Germantown cottage had dragged for years. New hinges, a fresh closer and it shuts like it should. Took less than an hour.
reviews.name: James K.

reviews.text: Twelve items on our inspection report and we closed in two weeks. Every small fix done in one day, with photos sent to our agent that night.
reviews.name: Priya L.

reviews.text: A ceiling fan in our twelve-foot hallway and two light fixtures swapped. He brought the right ladder, checked the boxes first and cleaned up after.
reviews.name: Tom W.
reviews.service: Ceiling fan and light fixture swaps

reviews.text: Three holes from old curtain rods and a long crack above the mantle. You cannot find any of them now, and the paint match is perfect.
reviews.name: Angela S.

reviews.text: Mounted a 55-inch TV on a plaster wall and two floating shelves beside it. Everything level, no cracks, and he explained what anchor he used and why.
reviews.name: Marcus D.

proof.guarantee: If a fix we made does not hold within a year, tell us and we come back to redo it at no charge.
